Runs every working bundle 3 times more, measured the same way, cooling down in between, and shows the average and the spread. Takes about %1$s min.
With root: real CPU cycles and instructions (Android\'s simpleperf) and the GPU clock and load the system hides from apps. Without root: the game\'s own CPU time and the CPU clocks.

The FPS and 1% / 0.1% lows are measured by our HUD from when the game renders, after the warm-up. A game\'s own benchmark is found by its .exe (Presets for the list, or type your own arguments). A benchmark that quits by itself is measured to its end, so every run covers the same scenes. Other games: whatever is on screen is measured (a menu scene, a loaded save), so keep it the same between runs.

Your own clock limits for this game. A lower GPU ceiling and a higher floor for the big CPU cores give the CPU more of the shared power budget: fewer stutters at the same FPS. Applied at once, held for the whole game and put back when it closes.
the system allows up to %1$s (heat or another limiter)

Each bundle runs once per chosen clock variant: a lower GPU ceiling, a floor for the big CPU cores, both. Best with a game: the winner\'s limits are applied to the game with the bundle and can be fine-tuned in the in-game menu › Performance.
The clock search needs root for this app (each APK variant, standard or AnTuTu, is granted root separately).
